ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the base layer and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed as streaks and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark mass centered on the fluke body. High-intensity contiguous white clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. A dense network of white linear filaments is mapped across the medial regions of both lobes, more concentrated on the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees; the vertex is well-defined and centered.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with an average pixel amplitude of 5-10 pixels. Right lobe exhibits lower-frequency serrations with smoother segments between nodes. The extreme distal tips show irregular, high-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trailing from the distal tips toward the median notch, with a distinct outward convexity on the upper trailing boundary of the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-intensity white clusters with irregular circular boundaries located at the outer terminal margins of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) varying in length; longest disruptions observed on the left lobe, trending diagonally from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged, irregular loss of smooth contour at the distal tips; presence of numerous overlapping linear scars (rake marks) across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of high-intensity splashing water droplets at the base of the fluke near the water line, partially occluding the insertion point of the peduncle.
